scope: Exact four-module source bridge from a terminal private native digital initiative to the existing person-scoped memory outbox.

checks.exactContractSelection: Only DelegatedDigitalWork/v4 and DelegatedInitiativeDigitalWork/v1 are selected; the existing private owner, binding, retention, activation and terminal-state filters remain.
checks.nativeProvenance: Read-only reconstruction checks retained adopted intent, original admission sequence, owner binding, canonical ingress hash, work/spec/mandate hashes. It does not issue another execution grant or rename native origin as owner ingress.
checks.terminalTruth: A succeeded/verified worker result requires the original completed parent and matching result hash. A stopped parent cannot manufacture a success memory. Confirmed failure remains a failure; ambiguous execution remains outside the selected terminal states.
checks.personAndTrust: The document retains exact private person/source/project scope and model_inference_unconfirmed trust. Native text is explicitly labelled as Eva initiative and no new instruction, authority, general skill or proven improvement.
checks.durableLifecycle: Existing activation cutoff, scoped outbox, stable work document ID, enqueue-before-marker reconciliation, erased/tombstone handling and server-owned document erasure binding remain unchanged.
checks.ordinaryRoute: The existing ordinary source loader and memory submission route remain; this change adds no new daemon, queue, storage backend or model call.
checks.exceptionBoundary: InitiativeMandateDenied inherits ConversationConflict, so native source failures use the existing source_unavailable skip disposition.
checks.testPrecision: The corrected confirmed-failure test no longer claims a parent stop; actual late-success-after-stop rejection is tested separately.

1 ordinary stop/resume/readback/erasure lifecycle in separate database

Publish installation and any subsequent authentic native outcome or later recall as separately measured evidence.
